For nearly 30 years, customers have turned to the brand to mark life's biggest moments, from birthdays and holidays to graduations and gatherings. \r\n This episode of "Here's the Deal" looks at our investment in Nothing Bundt Cakes, the largest specialty bakery franchisor in the U.S., with approximately 800 bakeries spanning 45 states and Canada. \r\n Beyond the frosting is a business model we're drawn to: durable, repeatable, and remarkably resilient. Nothing Bundt Cakes is built around something more lasting: occasions. For nearly 30 years, customers have turned to the brand to mark life's biggest moments, from birthdays and holidays to graduations and gatherings.

Beyond the frosting is a business model we're drawn to: durable, repeatable, and remarkably resilient. The operating model is simple, and demand is tied to occasions that we believe hold up through the economic cycle. The result is a steady, recurring demand that looks less like a typical dessert concept and more like a subscription business.

What drew us in as a partner is how much growth is already baked in and how much we can help bring to life: a largely contracted pipeline of more than 600 signed-but-not-yet-opened bakeries, meaningful room to deepen relationships through a sharper digital experience, and significant opportunity as national awareness catches up to the devotion of its fans. It's a reminder that some of the most compelling businesses are sitting in plain sight.

Watch the episode to see how the deal came together.
